name: SkySEOManager – Bulk SEO Editor
author: Siteskyline Plugins

sections.description:
SkySEOManager is a powerful bulk SEO editor that helps you manage your website’s SEO meta data efficiently. Edit multiple posts’ meta titles, descriptions, and featured images from a single screen.

Key Features

  • Bulk edit SEO meta titles and descriptions
  • Real-time character count and SEO score indicators
  • Featured image management
  • Compatible with popular SEO plugins:
    • Yoast SEO
    • Rank Math
    • All in One SEO
  • Filter posts by SEO issues:
    • Missing meta titles
    • Missing meta descriptions
    • Missing featured images
    • Too short/long titles
    • Too short/long descriptions
  • Auto-save functionality
  • Built-in SEO length validation
  • Support for custom post types

Perfect For

  • Content managers handling large websites
  • SEO professionals managing multiple posts
  • Website owners wanting to optimize their SEO
  • Digital marketers improving meta data in bulk

Professional SEO Management

  • Visual indicators for SEO score
  • Character count monitoring
  • Instant feedback on meta data quality
  • Efficient bulk editing interface
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/skyseomanager directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Access the bulk editor via ‘SkySEOManager’ in the admin menu
  4. Configure plugin settings under ‘SkySEOManager > Settings’
sections.faq:
Is this compatible with my existing SEO plugin?

Yes, SkySEOManager works seamlessly with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO Pack.

Will this plugin override my existing SEO data?

No, the plugin safely manages your SEO data without overriding existing settings from other SEO plugins.

Can I edit custom post types?

Yes, you can enable SEO management for any public custom post type in the plugin settings.

Does it support featured image management?

Yes, you can manage featured images alongside meta titles and descriptions in the bulk editor.
